purpose: Route natural-language questions asked about a verified property timeline event into the correct evidence, legal-effect, party, causation or comparison pathway without changing the underlying timeline scope.
core_principle: TIMELINE EVENT → CITIZEN QUESTION → EVENT-SCOPED ROUTE → EVIDENCE/LAW → ANSWER
rules: A timeline question about an event retains the approved property and event identity.
What happened here is answered from approved event facts, not from event names alone.
Why did this change requires causation analysis and cannot be answered from chronology alone.
Who was involved uses party and role evidence and does not infer ownership from participation.
What law applied requires the relevant legal version for the event date.
What document records this distinguishes document date, event date and registration date.
What changed because of this distinguishes affected property interests rather than treating every event as ownership change.
Before/after questions may expand only to the necessary neighbouring timeline scope.
Uncertainty in the event remains visible in every derived answer.
A timeline interaction cannot expose restricted evidence or internal reasoning.
hard_stops: Never infer an event cause from chronology alone.
Never infer a party's legal role from appearance in a document alone.
Never treat event type as proof of legal effect.
Never expand to unrelated timeline events.
Never substitute current law for the event-date law without verification.
Never convert an unanswered timeline question into a definitive conclusion.
